Container.Name: nomad_dozzle
Container.Overview: Optional log viewer for Project N.O.M.A.D. The "Service Logs & Metrics" link in NOMAD's Settings opens it on port 9999, so keep the host port at 9999 if you want that link to work.[br][br] Container actions and shell access are turned off, matching upstream: Dozzle has no login and can see the Docker socket.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Keep at 9999 for NOMAD's Settings link to work.

Config.Name: DOZZLE_ENABLE_ACTIONS
Config.Description: Leave false: true lets anyone on your LAN stop/restart containers.

Config.Name: DOZZLE_ENABLE_SHELL
Config.Description: Leave false: shell access plus the Docker socket is root on the host.
